_comment: Hyva theme feature defaults. See core features.json for the contract.

wishlist.removeConfirmationComment: Hyva's wish list remove control posts straight away (hyva.postForm) - there is no confirmation dialog.

minicart.removeConfirmationComment: Hyva's cart drawer removes a line directly via Alpine's deleteItemFromCart - there is no confirmation dialog.

review.formBehindTabComment: Hyva renders no product tabs at all; the review form is in the page and its Alpine component initialises when scrolled into view.
